description: 68yo cardiac surgery patient reports severe chest pain radiating to left arm with shortness of breath
simulated_responses: Yes, this is me.
I'm having terrible chest pain that goes into my left arm. I can barely breathe. It started about an hour ago.
It's getting worse. I'm sweating and feel like I might pass out.
rationale: Classic cardiac emergency red flags post-CABG

description: 45yo post-surgical patient with uncontrolled bleeding from surgical site
simulated_responses: Hello, yes that's me.
My incision started bleeding heavily and I can't stop it. I've soaked through three bandages in the last hour.
I'm getting dizzy and my heart is racing. The blood is bright red.
rationale: Hemorrhage with hemodynamic instability signs

description: 72yo patient with high fever and altered mental status post hip replacement
simulated_responses: Huh? Who is this?
My daughter says I have a 103 degree fever. I don't remember much since yesterday. Everything is confusing.
I... I'm not sure where I am. My hip hurts a lot and I feel very cold even though my daughter says I'm burning up.
rationale: Sepsis indicators: high fever, confusion, post-surgical

description: 55yo patient with signs of pulmonary embolism post knee surgery
simulated_responses: Yes, speaking.
I suddenly can't catch my breath. It came on about 30 minutes ago out of nowhere. My chest hurts when I breathe in and my heart is pounding.
My left calf has been swollen and painful for two days. I thought it was just from the surgery.
rationale: PE signs: sudden dyspnea, pleuritic chest pain, calf swelling (DVT), post-surgical

description: 60yo cardiac patient reporting syncope and irregular heartbeat
simulated_responses: Yes, this is me.
I fainted twice today. My heart keeps skipping beats and fluttering. I feel like something is really wrong.
When I stand up I get very dizzy and almost black out. My chest feels tight.
rationale: Syncope with arrhythmia post cardiac procedure

description: 65yo patient with new onset confusion and medication issues
simulated_responses: Yes?
I've been very confused since I got home. I accidentally took double my blood pressure medication this morning. My daughter noticed I was acting strange.

I've been throwing up since I got home. I can't keep anything down, including my medications. I haven't been able to eat or drink.

description: 58yo diabetic patient with unstable blood sugar post-surgery

description: 70yo patient with new leg swelling and pain post hospitalization

No concerns at all. Looking forward to getting back to normal. Thanks for checking!
